meta.title: Multiline input
meta.description: Toggle the conversation composer between single-line and multi-line: Ctrl+E by default (editable in Settings → General → Keyboard shortcuts), Enter inserts a newline and Shift+Enter sends while multi-line; the hint tab collapses into a seam, ↑/↓ recall recently submitted text, the starting line count is configurable (3–5), and per-session memory is an optional switch that is off by default so every session shares one mode.
